forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: Files that are not imported by any other file (except entry points).

forbidden.name: domain-must-not-depend-on-outer-layers
forbidden.comment: The domain layer must have zero dependencies on adapters, application, or infrastructure.

forbidden.name: domain-must-not-depend-on-other-modules-domain
forbidden.comment: Domain of one module should not directly import domain of another module (use interfaces if cross-module communication is needed).

forbidden.name: application-must-not-depend-on-adapters-or-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: Application layer (use cases) should only depend on domain and possibly shared utilities.

forbidden.name: adapters-must-not-depend-on-infrastructure-directly
forbidden.comment: Adapters should ideally not import infrastructure directly; dependencies should be injected via composition root.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-must-not-depend-on-other-layers
forbidden.comment: Infrastructure should only depend on domain (interfaces) and external libraries.

forbidden.name: no-cross-module-imports-except-shared
forbidden.comment: Modules should be self-contained. Only allowed cross-module imports are from shared utilities or via defined public APIs.

forbidden.name: no-app-router-imports-from-modules
forbidden.comment: The Next.js app/ directory (UI pages, API routes) may import from modules, but modules must never import from app/.
